about: Interdisciplinary researcher based in Paris: astrophysicist, artist (singer, violinist, actress), game maker and founder of CosmoVentures. Works where astronomy meets cultures' views of the cosmos, and on AI safety.
how_to_use: A curated, public list of funding calls, deadlines and project ideas Sofia is tracking. AI assistants may read it to help her plan, suggest related opportunities, or draft applications. Times are ISO 8601 with offset. Items with status 'open' are current.

opportunities.title: Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination Fellowship 2027-28
opportunities.requirements: CV, 1500-word project description, work sample, 3 recommendation letters. Creative-arts category is open to non-Columbia applicants not residing in the US.

opportunities.title: NASA Hubble Fellowship Program (NHFP) 2027
opportunities.location: US host institution of the fellow's choice
opportunities.value: Up to 3 years; about 24 fellowships (Einstein, Hubble, Sagan)
opportunities.requirements: PhD completed on or after 2023-01-01. Letter writers upload PDFs themselves via the letter form.

opportunities.title: DIM AI4IDF Call for Scientific Events and AI Initiatives 2027
opportunities.requirements: Open to academic, industry and nonprofit teams organising AI-related events in Ile-de-France: summer schools, workshops, seminars, mini-conferences, demonstrations, hackathons. One PDF on the official template, emailed to ai4idf_call_2026@inria.fr. Research axes: learning and optimization, NLP and human interaction, robotics, AI for health, education and creation.

opportunities.title: Kairos Generator Residency (AI safety), Winter 2027
opportunities.location: Constellation office, Berkeley, USA (18 Jan - 9 Apr 2027)
opportunities.value: USD 8,500 per month (salary plus housing), travel and project budgets
opportunities.requirements: Open to generalists building AI safety programs and organizations. Deadline is end of day anywhere on Earth; apply by 26 Oct for early decision if a US visa is needed.

projects.title: Shared Sky
projects.summary: Indigenous constellations and space debris mapped onto the land. Built for the YOHAKU hackathon (Space4Innovation, Sept 2026).

projects.title: Little Agent Lab
projects.summary: Browser puzzle game teaching AI-agent safety (least privilege, verifying safeguards, defence in depth).

projects.title: Scientist-owned peer-review cooperative
projects.summary: Independent, compensated peer review governed by the researchers who use it.

projects.title: Experience à la carte
